snippet_primary: "I would give zero stars if I could. I had a customer dispute their purchase of my product, which I clearly state on my checkout page that I don't give refunds. Gumroad responded and said I lost the dispute because I don't have a refund policy. Then a week later I discovered that my account had been shut down...with no warning or notification. The customer 'support' just sounds like an AI bot writing me a canned email. It's horrible. Don't use Gumroad."
subject_exact: seller-reported loss of a payment dispute on Gumroad due to absence of a stated refund policy, followed by unexplained account shutdown
local_qualifiers: clearly stated no refunds on checkout page but lost the dispute for not having a refund policy
